readout.limitation: At most16 cases/seed, one root action and exploration tape; no full-learning effect claimed.

paired5.interaction_sign: (fixed-deploy - old-deploy) - (fixed-train - old-train), for G and each actual outcome indicator.
paired5.early_terminal_convention: All16 cases remain in outcome-effect denominators; pre-root cases have zero arm difference. Root G is undefined for them and excluded only from G means.
paired5.readout_contract: Only already-collected CPU linear257 readouts <=300steps; no postprocess fitting, tuning, new gate or IL/RL.
paired5.eval_contract: All four arms keep net.eval(), so dropout is disabled. Does NOT reproduce original train-mode actor dropout, mixtures of historical checkpoints, or replay state noise. A controlled frozen continuation contract, not complete original training-behavior reproduction. No new intervention.
paired5.scope: Frozen policy generation/label continuation effects only; continuous ReplayBufferMC window reconstruction not altered; one exploration tape, no retraining.
